purpose: Define the mandatory hardening architecture for Evidence-Based Source-to-Competency Candidate Generation before L2.3-C can become a trusted input to L2.3-D.
principle: Candidate generation must remain conservative, deterministic, evidence-based, and human-review dependent. Signal presence alone must not establish competency relevance.

token_aware_matching.purpose: Prevent substring and partial-word matches from creating false competency signals.

signal_classification.purpose: Classify matched signals according to their topical role and evidential strength.

specificity_weighting.purpose: Give distinctive competency-specific phrases greater evidential weight than generic occupational terms.

signal_independence.purpose: Prevent multiple overlapping phrases from being incorrectly treated as independent evidence.

phrase_hierarchy_collapse.purpose: Collapse parent and child phrase matches so that hierarchical variants do not inflate signal counts.

negative_context_check.purpose: Detect contextual language indicating that a matched term is being discussed negatively, hypothetically, historically, comparatively, or outside the competency meaning.

evidence_proximity.purpose: Evaluate whether supporting signals occur within a meaningful local evidence window rather than merely appearing somewhere in the same source.

competency_scoring.purpose: Calculate deterministic competency relevance using controlled signal evidence rather than raw keyword counts.

competitor_detection.purpose: Identify competing competency interpretations where the same evidence could reasonably support multiple competencies.

deterministic_thresholds.purpose: Use explicit reproducible thresholds for candidate classification with no hidden or nondeterministic decisions.

candidate_classification.purpose: Classify results using controlled confidence and evidence rules while preserving candidate-only status.

human_review_required.purpose: Ensure automatically generated mappings never become confirmed mappings without human review.

non_negotiable_rules: The canonical CSP11 blueprint remains authoritative.
Source content evidence remains the substantive basis for competency mapping.
Bibliographic metadata must not be treated as competency evidence.
Generic standalone keywords must not establish competency relevance.
Overlapping signals must not be counted as independent evidence.
Phrase hierarchy must not artificially inflate scores.
Evidence from distant unrelated sections must not be treated as equivalent to locally coherent evidence.
A candidate mapping must never be automatically confirmed.
No new competencies may be created by the pipeline.
No automatic competency reclassification is permitted.
No padding of candidate mappings is permitted.
Sources without extractable evidence must remain unmapped and require human review.
The same source-to-competency pair must not be generated more than once.
Candidate generation must be deterministic and reproducible.
Every generated candidate must retain an auditable evidence basis.
Human review remains the final authority.

promotion_gate.condition: L2.3-C must pass all hardened signal-taxonomy controls and deterministic validation before its output is treated as a trusted input to L2.3-D.
required_validation: flutter/code validation appropriate to the implementation passes
Only intentional L2.3-C hardening changes remain
